text: Fictional request: Please prepare one 1,200-word article about caring for indoor plants. The budget is $240 for the first article. We can provide a style guide. AI-generated drafts are allowed, but a person must check all facts. Please send a short outline before writing.

fields.budget: The stated fee, budget, or compensation amount, with currency
fields.deadline: The stated deadline or delivery date
fields.deliverable: The stated deliverable, output, or item to be delivered
fields.revisions: The stated number or policy of revisions

ai_permission.instructions: What does the brief explicitly say about using AI? Do not infer permission from silence.

criteria.restricted: AI use is explicitly restricted or prohibited
criteria.not_stated: AI use is not addressed or is ambiguous

external_contact.instructions: Does the brief explicitly request communication outside the platform?

criteria.not_stated: Off-platform contact is not requested or is ambiguous

follow_up.description: Draft one short, polite question asking the client to clarify a material missing condition. Do not invent facts. If nothing material is missing ask which condition to confirm first.
